title: UE Blueprint BuildGraph
description: Validate and compile a declarative managed Blueprint Graph definition into an approved, recoverable Workflow v2 execution.

recipes.title: Build and verify one managed Blueprint Graph
recipes.description: Compile a versioned BuildGraph definition to Workflow v2, execute the approved plan, and verify ownership, structure, layout, and recovery evidence.

steps.purpose: Read the current managed definition and structural Graph baseline.
Validate ownership and compile the definition into a normalized Workflow v2 plan.
Execute the exact approved Workflow with one transaction, deferred compile, durable checkpoints, and existing rollback semantics.
Verify managed refs, graph identity, structural diff, compile status, and layout diagnostics.

result.summary: Approved declarative Blueprint Graph reconciliation with managed ownership and Workflow recovery evidence.
evidence: Workflow plan digest and run ID
success: the definition passed bounded schema and ownership validation
the exact planned Workflow digest was approved and executed
all declared refs resolve to stable managed nodes
idempotent replay produces no duplicate nodes or connections

resources.description: Ownership, planning, Workflow recovery, and verification rules.
